reviews.text: Thank you, April, for your patience with me!! I am very happy with how the glass turned out in my shower! Quick, professional, and quality work!
reviews.author: Megan English

reviews.text: Thanks to April and Holly for your kindness and care. Thanks to Jessie and Jamie for a fast and professional installation. Job well done by Champion Glass and Mirror. I will definitely recommend to friend and neighbors.
reviews.author: Carol Tally

reviews.text:
This company was used by my builder West River Homes.
They hired these guys to come out and install new shower glass. They did not listen to my request whatsoever and I ended up with something I had to just accept since I’ve been waiting over a year for this project to complete.
The installers were very nice but did a horrible job on actually sealing the glass. They also damaged the wall/sheetrock in our bathroom, didn’t tell me, and when I saw it they said they tried to put silicone over it to cover it up.
Mind you, you cannot paint over silicone… so I then had to call a sheet rock guy out to scrape, re texture, and paint the wall again.
They weren’t even going to tell me it was damaged they just tried to cover it up. Photo is attached…

We called them back out to fix the seal around the glass a second time because of how bad it looked and water was leaking out onto the tile on the other side of the glass.
After they “fixed” it, the water is still leaking out from under the glass to the outside tile.

Working with this company has been horrible and I wouldn’t redolent to anyone.
reviews.author: Nicole Fox

reviews.text: These people at Champion Glass & Mirror are some Pro’s now. Very polite and friendly and very respectful to our home. They cleaned up after themselves too. Did the job quickly and was right on the time they said they would start the job. I will always use Champion Glass & Mirror glass needs from here on. Thank You ! Beautiful Job !
reviews.author: Car Mack

reviews.text: After probably 45 minutes of a calling around to “glass” suppliers in the area, I finally called champion glass and mirror. The secretary who answered was so nice and helpful. They had large size glass that I needed at a decent price. I do a lot of window pane replacements, and I will definitely start checking here as my new  go to.
reviews.author: James Farrell

reviews.text: Richard came out today & replaced the glass in our master bedroom.  Excellent workmanship!  Richard was very professional & thoughtful coming in & out of our home.  Greatly appreciated his integrity & honesty, including his suggestions/recommendations for replacing our shower glass in the future.  Thank U Richard & Thank U Champion Glass for being here for us!   Cindy & Jim
reviews.author: Cynthia Mitchell

reviews.text: Champion Glass did not install our frameless shower, but they fixed the awfull job done by Azle Glass (now out of business).  Richard (and April) did an outstanding job and went above and beyond to adjust our glass shower door, saving us hundreds of dollars it would have cost us to buy a shorter fixed pane.  We will always call on Champion Glass in the futur.
reviews.author: Pete H

reviews.text: I absolutely adore these people.  They did several shower doors for me and were prompt, courteous and very kind.  They have even come back years after their work was finished to troubleshoot and solve an issue for me.  I can’t speak highly enough about them and I would highly recommend them to anyone!! Thank you so much April and everyone at Champion Glass.
reviews.author: Katharine Senter

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic. The positive reviews are detailed, mention specific staff and projects, and express genuine satisfaction. The single critical review is also specific (damaged sheetrock, poor sealing) and credible, indicating a real customer experience. The business has a long history (43 years) and a strong BBB rating with no complaints, supporting its legitimacy. The low overall review count is a minor anomaly but not a red flag for fakery.
fake_signals: Low review volume (29 on Google, 10 on Houzz) for a 43-year-old business could indicate limited online engagement, but is not a direct fake signal.
authentic_signals: Specific employee names mentioned (April, Holly, Jessie, Jamie, Richard)
Detailed project descriptions (shower glass, window pane replacements, fixing previous installer's work)
Mix of praise and specific constructive feedback in the negative review
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistent and positive across Google (4.8) and Houzz (4.4). BBB A+ rating with no complaints found. Yelp data shows no rating or reviews, which is not a discrepancy but an absence of data.
